validation_note: 73 non-GUI cases and 3 real Tk cases passed. The final diagnostic-only change adds published frequency-window lookback for missing anchors; its three affected frequency cases were rerun (two overlap the earlier batch). 77 distinct cases, 79 passing test executions. XML results were generated before the context interruption, not rerun to close documentation.

initial_failures.cause: New inactive-reference service SLEEP was not registered in the synthetic calendar; importer correctly rejected orphan references. Added an all-inactive calendar row; subsequent diagnostics passed.
The new Tk regression initially used the actual Saturday default instead of the intended synthetic active Monday. Set the test planning date explicitly; all three Tk cases subsequently passed.

clock_fix.cause: strftime(%H:%M) truncated saved seconds before sending an explicit departure to the service.
clock_fix.change: Prefill time.isoformat(); strictly validate HH:MM or HH:MM:SS at the controller. Invalid or cleared explicit input cannot silently fall back to the saved departure.

synthetic_real_tk_regression.flow: actual Tk panel -> DesktopController.plan_static -> StaticPlanner.plan -> synthetic SQLite catalog

clock_fix.explicit_edit_HH_MM: 17:30 means 17:30:00 and may board 17:30:20 by explicit user choice

missing_schedule_fix.cause: Shared scheduled queries correctly filter null origin departures, but the planner treated the absence of returned rows as absence of service.
missing_schedule_fix.change: New diagnostic-only Catalog.has_unresolved_boarding; existing public query outputs are unchanged. Shared private service-date/calendar iteration is reused.
